base_setup_commands: apt-get update && apt-get install -y git curl pkg-config libssl-dev ca-certificates build-essential
activation_command: export RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup && export CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo && export PATH="/root/.cargo/bin:$PATH"
activation_validation_command: bash -c 'export RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup && export CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo && export PATH="/root/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && rustc --version && cargo --version && echo ACTIVATION_OK'
runtime_smoke_command: export RUSTUP_HOME=/root/.rustup && export CARGO_HOME=/root/.cargo && export PATH="/root/.cargo/bin:$PATH" && cd /workspace/rust && cargo build --package firezone-relay

runtime_profile.notes: Rust 1.75.0 is required as specified in rust-toolchain.toml. The firezone-relay package uses proptest for property-based testing.

notes: Base image debian:bookworm-slim provides git and curl. Rust 1.75.0 is installed via rustup. The project is a Rust workspace with the firezone-relay package as the target. Tests require the 'proptest' feature flag. The fix.patch modifies server.rs to properly handle IPv6 address relay capability checks. The test.patch adds a new proptest test case for IPv6 ping-pong relay functionality. build-essential is included to provide the cc linker required for Rust compilation.
